SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_campaign WHERE owner_type='MERCHANT' AND owner_merchant_id=#{merchantId}) AS total_campaign_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_campaign WHERE owner_type='MERCHANT' AND owner_merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND status='ACTIVE') AS active_campaign_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_campaign WHERE owner_type='MERCHANT' AND owner_merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND status='PENDING_REVIEW') AS pending_review_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_claim cl JOIN coupon_campaign c ON c.id=cl.campaign_id WHERE c.owner_type='MERCHANT' AND c.owner_merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND cl.claimed_at >= #{monthStart} AND cl.claimed_at < #{monthEnd}) AS month_issued_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.issued_count),0) FROM coupon_campaign c WHERE c.owner_type='MERCHANT' AND c.owner_merchant_id=#{merchantId}) AS issued_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_instance i JOIN coupon_template t ON t.id=i.coupon_template_id WHERE t.owner_type='MERCHANT' AND t.owner_merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND i.status='USED') AS used_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) FROM coupon_ledger l JOIN coupon_instance i ON i.id=l.coupon_instance_id JOIN coupon_template t ON t.id=i.coupon_template_id WHERE t.owner_type='MERCHANT' AND t.owner_merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND l.action='CONSUME') AS driven_order_count

SELECT c.id AS campaign_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_instance i WHERE i.coupon_template_id=c.template_id AND i.status='USED') AS used_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) FROM coupon_ledger l JOIN coupon_instance i ON i.id=l.coupon_instance_id WHERE i.coupon_template_id=c.template_id AND l.action='CONSUME') AS driven_order_count FROM coupon_campaign c WHERE c.owner_type='MERCHANT' AND c.owner_merchant_id=#{merchantId}

SELECT c.id AS campaign_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_instance i WHERE i.coupon_template_id=c.template_id AND i.status='USED') AS used_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) FROM coupon_ledger l JOIN coupon_instance i ON i.id=l.coupon_instance_id WHERE i.coupon_template_id=c.template_id AND l.action='CONSUME') AS driven_order_count FROM coupon_campaign c WHERE c.owner_type='MERCHANT' AND c.id IN #{item}
